name: Mindless
description: No mind to reach. Does not roll Morale and cannot be parleyed. Immune to charmed, frightened, and confused. Required on every Undead and Automaton, paired with Intelligent.

name: Intelligent
description: Retains or was given a mind. Parley is possible, may cast spells, may command lesser creatures of its kind. Not automatically immune to mind-affecting conditions. Required on every Undead and Automaton, paired with Mindless.

name: Shapechanger
description: Can alter its physical form. Cuts across types: lycanthropes are Humanoid, kitsune are Spirit, and other shapechangers sit elsewhere again.

name: Swarm
description: One creature that is a mass of small bodies. Resistant to damage from single-target effects, immune to conditions from single-target effects, cannot be grappled, occupies an area. While at half HP or lower, their attacks deal half damage, rounded up. Distinct from the Horde archetype, which is many separate creatures under troop rules.

name: Amorphous
description: No fixed form. Squeezes through any gap, cannot be grappled, has no anatomy to target, and ignores terrain that is not sealed. Every Ooze carries it.
